note: Private campground in pines off Church Rd south of Long Lake, with a swim pond and beach, an inflatable aqua park, a jump pillow and weekend events, and nature trails and tubing on the Brill River. Mostly seasonal: about 33 of its 108 sites are sold by the night. It sits on an ATV route. --Claude
summary: Operator site and ResNexus read. About 33 nightly sites of 108 (31%), the rest seasonal. 2027 quotes: $45 May weeknights, $55 June weeknights, $65 summer weekends (2-night minimum), premium pull-through $50/$80. Over the $50 gate all summer; no gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park. Google 4.7 (128). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate, borderline): ResNexus 2027 quotes for the ordinary overnight sites (A1-A20, R1-R11, ~30 sites) are $55 on a mid-June Tuesday and $65 on summer Fridays and Saturdays; only May weeknights quote $45 (premium pull-throughs $50 in May, $80 in summer). The site advertises '$10 discount on overnight RV sites - Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday night stays!'; whether the $55 Tuesday quote already includes it is not shown. gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest St. Paul 135 km). Not a Good Sam Park (good_sam false). So under $50 only in the shoulder season; summer is over.

LONG-STAY: mostly seasonal at about 31% nightly (overnight A1-A20, R1-R11 and 3 tent sites = 33; seasonal rows H, V-Z, B1-B3, C, D, E = ~75). Posts nightly rates and books nightly online, so tests 1-4 pass; no wording discouraging nightly guests. Google 4.7 (128). Note says 'Mostly seasonal: about 33 of its 108 sites are sold by the night'.
SEASONAL AGE RULE (not a drop): the V-Z seasonal rows are 'reserved for retired couples or families with Children 13+'; the overnight sites carry no age rule.
OHV (flag only): 'WE ARE LOCATED RIGHT ON THE TRAIL!' (ATV page) and 'ATV friendly'. A general family campground with ATV access, not an ATV base camp.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: the Brill River (about 15-20 m wide on Esri imagery, so creekside at most) runs east of the campground behind a band of woods; the RV loops are 60+ m from it. The tent sites are 'alongside the Brill River'.
PIN 45.6531,-91.6753 is on Church Rd at the entrance; the loops centre about 45.6517,-91.6750 (~160 m). No move needed.
